Hot tub built into the stage

The covered terrace now has a hot tub set right into the stage. In the evening, warm up in it with a view over the complex.

When you're celebrating, cover the hot tub and you have a stage for a band, DJ, speeches or a wedding ceremony. It can be used as either the hot tub or the stage, not both at once.

  • Heated water
  • Do not switch off: filtration, water treatment and heating must run continuously, or the water will spoil.
  • Under the roof and behind curtains, usable in cold weather
  • A full stage when covered
